rdfs:label: mappingRelation
rdfs:comment: Superproperty of all SKOS cross-scheme mapping relations — `exactMatch`, `closeMatch`, `broadMatch`, `narrowMatch`, `relatedMatch`. Asserts that two Concepts in different schemes are related, without specifying how.
notes: Use the most specific subproperty available — bare `mappingRelation` only when the kind of mapping is genuinely unknown. Subproperty of `urn:solid:semanticRelation`, specialised for links between concepts in different schemes (in-scheme links use `broader`/`narrower`/`related`).

examples.title: A generic mapping between two concepts

history.note: Notes now state mappingRelation is a subproperty of semanticRelation; added relatedMatch to seeAlso.
